استنجدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَدُوا (istanjadū) /is.tan.d͡ʒa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# اُسْتُنْجِدُوا (ustunjidū) /us.tun.d͡ʒi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# اِسْتَنْجِدُوا (istanjidū) /is.tan.d͡ʒi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
